# Security policy

This independent SDK is not an official Telegram, Fragment, or TON product.
Never attach a wallet mnemonic, Fragment cookie, provider key, proxy password,
production database, or raw request log to an issue. For a suspected credential
leak, revoke/rotate the affected credential immediately and remove it from
accessible logs. Redaction in a client does not prevent backend storage.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting if the maintainer enables it. Until
then open only a minimal non-sensitive issue requesting a private reporting
channel. Do not publish exploit credentials or secret-bearing reproductions.
